lcc_original: 上帝看全地都敗壞了：凡有血肉的在地上所行的全都敗壞。
notes: 上帝 (LCC) ↔ 神 (UNV) both map to WH0430 (Elohim); systematic LCC/UNV difference, no ambiguity
LCC 看 absorbs only 觀看 (WH07200+WTH8799); UNV 見 maps to WAH02009 (וְהִנֵּה hinneh, presentational particle 'and behold') which has no explicit LCC counterpart — kept implicit as {<WAH02009>}
LCC 全地 ↔ UNV 世界, both receive WH0776 (אֶרֶץ); 全 is LCC-only emphasis with no SN
{<WAH0853>} (אֶת direct-object marker) placed before 全地 in first clause (matching Hebrew word order: וַיַּרְא...אֶת-הָאָרֶץ)

LCC second clause topicalizes the direct object: 所行的全都敗壞 (their-deeds [all] corrupted) vs UNV 都敗壞了行為 (corrupted [their] way); {<WAH0853>} placed before 所行的<WH01870> to mark it as the Hebrew direct object despite the reordering
LCC 所行的 ↔ UNV 行為 (WH01870, דֶּרֶךְ way/conduct); LCC uses a verbal relative clause while UNV uses a noun, but semantic content matches
LCC 全 before 都敗壞 in second clause is LCC-only (no SN), intensifying 都敗壞<WH07843><WTH8689>
